changelog:
AI Automation Agency Blueprint skill v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides a comprehensive step-by-step playbook to build, price, sell, and scale an AI agent services business.
- Includes actionable frameworks for assessing agency readiness, designing business models, and selecting high-demand services.
- Offers templates for service packaging, value-based pricing strategies, and detailed sales/delivery processes.
- Equips users with quick commands and phase-based guidance for solo operators to 7-figure agencies.
- Emphasizes real economics and specific, actionable recommendations for agency success.
summary: Guide users to build, price, sell, and scale AI agent service agencies with actionable, economics-backed strategies for solo to 7-figure operations.
